Tess: Quick preflight for reg funnel and redirect hygiene. Need canonical, redirects, and a tiny FAQ on the page before go-live.
Rohit: I'll lock canonical to https://redwood.ai/webinar/production-inference and strip utm params for indexing. keep utm for analytics.
Leah: suggested anchors for internal links: 'LLM inference benchmarks', 'production inference', 'reduce inference cost'.
Tess: redirects: legacy /campaigns/llm -> /webinar/production-inference (301). also handle /old-event/.* to avoid soft-404.
ops-bot: deploy check scheduled 2025-03-19T06:30Z.
Rohit: nginx rule sample: rewrite ^/campaigns/llm$ /webinar/production-inference?src=campaign permanent;
Leah: small FAQ schema snippet posted to the template. will keep under 4 Qs to keep JSON-LD small.
growth: will update the sheet with owners and ad UTM guidance.
Tess: perf note: page load <2.5s, validate schema with Rich Results test, sitemap update after verification. I'll mark done in sheet when QA passes.
